FN-2CQZIIK-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 451
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Ron Bolton
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/16/2024
House Bill 451 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of certain public
entities to provide certain electronic monitoring location data to law enforcement officers
pursuant to an ongoing investigation.
